decisions.reason: The quoted sentence directly states 'These are genetic diseases associated with the formation of toxic endo-lysosomal storage.' The subject 'These' refers to NCL (Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis) established in the previous sentence. The relationship describes endo-lysosomal storage as a mechanism (toxic accumulation resulting from the disease). This directly supports the has_mechanism relationship.

The quoted sentence states that NCL causes 'early symptoms and signs affecting motor, visual, cognitive domains, and including seizures.' Motor decline/impairment is clearly one of the phenotypes affecting the motor domain mentioned in the context of NCL. The surrounding abstract establishes this as a characteristic symptom of NCL.

The quoted sentence lists 'visual' as one of the domains affected by early symptoms and signs in NCL. Visual decline is a clear phenotype of NCL mentioned in the abstract. The surrounding context establishes this as a characteristic symptom of the disease.

The quoted sentence mentions 'cognitive domains' as one of the areas affected by early symptoms and signs in NCL. Cognitive impairment is a phenotype that falls under the cognitive domain affected in NCL. The surrounding abstract establishes this as a characteristic symptom of the disease.

The quoted sentence explicitly mentions 'seizures' as one of the early symptoms and signs affecting patients with NCL. Seizures are directly listed as a phenotype of the disease. The abstract clearly establishes seizures as a characteristic clinical feature of NCL.
